q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# Analysis

## (a) Time left until resolution

NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release will occur in late August or early September 2026 (typically 4-6 weeks after the end of Q2). Given that today is August 15, 2026, the Q2 FY2027 earnings announcement is likely within 2-4 weeks.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

NVIDIA has explicitly provided forward guidance of **$91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027 revenue, announced on May 20, 2026. This creates a guidance range of $89.18 billion to $92.82 billion.

This is the company's own official forward guidance—the most direct and reliable signal available. Companies typically meet or beat their own guidance, especially when provided with a 2% cushion.

The actual reported Q2 FY2027 revenue should fall very close to this $91.0 billion figure, likely within the ±2% range. The most probable outcome is that NVIDIA reports revenue in the range of $89-93 billion.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

- **Demand disappointment**: Weaker-than-expected AI/data center demand
- **Supply constraints**: Inability to fulfill demand due to manufacturing or yield issues
- **Geopolitical factors**: The guidance explicitly excludes China Data Center compute revenue; additional export restrictions could reduce revenue
- **Macro recession**: Economic downturn reducing enterprise AI spending
- **Competitive pressure**: Loss of market share to AMD or other competitors
- **Conservative management**: If actual results came in significantly lower than guidance, suggesting management was overly aggressive

## (d) What would push the value higher?

- **Upside surprise**: Stronger-than-expected demand from AI infrastructure buildout
- **Accelerated cloud capex**: Hyperscalers increasing investment faster than anticipated
- **China geopolitical change**: If restrictions on China Data Center revenue were lifted, adding incremental revenue (though guidance explicitly excludes this)
- **Product mix**: Higher average selling prices (ASPs) due to favorable product mix (e.g., more H200 vs H100 sales)
- **Beat guidance**: NVIDIA reporting above the $91.0B ± 2% range

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The CURRENT RESEARCH directly provides NVIDIA's official forward guidance: **$91.0 billion ± 2%** for Q2 FY2027, announced May 20, 2026.

Additional context from the research:
- Q1 FY2027 actual revenue: $81.6 billion (85% YoY growth)
- Analyst consensus for Q2 FY2027: $91.8 billion
- Analyst range: $90.3 billion to $96.7 billion

---

## Reasoning

The question asks for "forward guidance" in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release. This is unambiguous—it's asking what revenue guidance NVIDIA will provide when it reports Q2 FY2027 results. That guidance has already been provided ($91.0B ± 2%), announced on May 20, 2026, well before the earnings release.

The range given (99.5 to 115.5 billion) is substantially higher than the actual guidance. This creates several possible interpretations:
1. The question may be asking for actual reported Q2 FY2027 revenue (not forward guidance for Q3)
2. The range might reflect analyst expectations rather than management guidance
3. There could be a misunderstanding in the question setup

However, taking the question literally—"What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release?"—the answer is the guidance already announced: $91.0 billion ± 2%.

Given:
- The official guidance of $91.0B ± 2% (range: $89.18B to $92.82B)
- Analyst consensus of $91.8B
- Historical pattern of NVIDIA meeting or slightly beating guidance
- The provided range extends well above this ($99.5B to $115.5B)

The most likely value for actual forward guidance announced in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release is **$91.0 billion**, with potential variance up to the $92.82B upper bound of the 2% range, though upside surprises to $95B+ are possible if demand significantly exceeds expectations.

The given range suggests this forecasting question may have a different resolution criterion than what appears in the text, but I'm forecasting based on the most literal interpretation: management's forward revenue guidance.

**Calibration**: I'm placing my median at $91.0B (the stated guidance), with the 10th-90th percentile range reflecting uncertainty around whether management will revise guidance upward (based on stronger-than-expected demand) or maintain it, and potential upside from analyst consensus being above guidance.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue is set at **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**. This outlook was provided on May 20, 2026, when NVIDIA announced its Q1 FY2027 financial results [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The company explicitly stated that this guidance does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

This guidance is higher than the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion, according to LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html). For context, NVIDIA reported record revenue of $81.6 billion for Q1 FY2027, an 85% increase year-over-year [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [barchart.com](https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3449043/what-to-expect-from-nvidia-s-q2-2027-earnings-report). Analysts' consensus for Q2 FY2027 revenue is $91.8 billion, with a range of $90.3 billion to $96.7 billion [tickerleague.com](https://tickerleague.com/companies/NVDA/estimates).
